% fancyvrb's \UseVerb with hyperref: the saved text inline in the text, a
% heading, and the table of contents, as in the PDF.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{xcolor,fancyvrb}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\SaveVerb{v}|uvh-text_a#b|
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents
Text \UseVerb{v} more.

\section{Head \UseVerb{v} end}

Body text.
\end{document}
